about_the_game:
Polygon Survivors is a 2D survivors-style roguelite combining frantic action, deep customization, and a unique minimalist art style. Face relentless waves of enemies and build devastating loadouts in every run.

Customize Your Arsenal

Choose from 9 different cannons, each with its own firing style and stats. Pair them with 4 distinct projectile types, each offering unique effects to suit your playstyle.

Unleash Powerful Supers

Unlock and choose from 9 unique supers at the start of each run—each capable of turning the tide of battle. Teleportation portals, decoys, clones... every choice matters.

 Summon to Dominate

During battle, call upon 4 different summons to fight by your side. Each has a clear role (healer, damage dealer, utility, etc.) and can be upgraded to fit your strategy.

 Build Your Perfect Loadout

Collect powerful power-ups (lasers, poison zones, spinning axes, and more) and upgrade your stats (speed, fire rate, damage, etc.) wave after wave. No two runs are the same—experiment with dozens of combinations and grow stronger with every attempt.
